title: Probing Entanglement Scaling Across a Quantum Phase Transition on a Quantum Computer
abstract: First demonstration of logarithmic entanglement scaling at criticality on a digital quantum computer using MERA on trapped-ion hardware. Reveals quantum phase transition with spontaneous symmetry breaking. Accurately represents infinite systems and long-range correlations with few qubits.
key_claims: First observation of log-law entanglement scaling at criticality on quantum hardware
MERA efficiently captures infinite-system properties with few qubits
Spontaneous symmetry breaking observed across quantum phase transition
